before.machines-c-groups.lisp:
; Layer C in the served core, seams S-GROUP and the exact lookup it stands on
; (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §8 item 9): the group directory's genesis from
; the profile's :groups list, the exact lookup of a key over a schema's
; published overlays and installed runs, newest first, and the identity
; decision (§4a) as two such lookups. A lookup is
; resumable: one source (one overlay, or one bounded run step) per call, its
; continuation in the transaction's row (LPHASE LBOUND LROW LVER), its query
; in the transaction's lookup area (+4), its decoded entries in the
; run reader rows (+84), its run cursor the transaction's. So it is called at
; :prepare while the transaction's identity decision is idle or done and
; resolve is not inside a run descent (:state otherwise). The genesis, the
; defcosts and the core wrappers (fn2-groups-core-events and
; fn2-identity-core-events, materialized in assembly-callbacks-c.lisp) are
; this book's.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-bind")
(include-book "name-directory-geometry")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version)))

(defconst *fn2-groups-sid* 8)
(assert-event (and (equal *fn2-groups-entry-field-name* 0) (equal *fn2-groups-entry-field-group* 1)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The exact lookup. The published overlay of SID (frozen) with the greatest
; SEQ below BOUND among rows O.. (K of them); BEST the row count when none.
(defun fn2-xl-newest-frozen (k o sid bound best fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp o))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) best
  (fn2-xl-newest-frozen (- k 1) (+ 1 o) sid bound
                        (if (and (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen*)
                                 (equal (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays) sid)
                                 (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)) (nfix bound))
                                 (or (not (and (natp best) (< best (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))))
                                     (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq best fn2-overlays)) (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)))))
                            o best)
                        fn2-overlays)))
(defthm fn2-xl-newest-frozen-natp
 (implies (natp best) (natp (fn2-xl-newest-frozen k o sid bound best fn2-overlays))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(in-theory (disable fn2-xl-newest-frozen))

; Restart TX's lookup from the newest overlay, noting SID's run version.
(defun fn2-xl-restart (tx sid fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed))))
 (b* ((version (fn2-run-version sid (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed) fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 version)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns))
      (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-overlays*) (lbound *fn2-u60-max*) (lrow 0) (lver version))))
  (mv :more fn2-succ-txns)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-xl-restart (tx sid fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed) (fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed))

; Done: TX's lookup idles.
(defun fn2-xl-done (tx code fn2-succ-txns)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-succ-txns :guard (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns)))
 (if (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)))
     (let ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-idle*) (lbound 0) (lrow 0) (lver 0))))
      (mv code fn2-succ-txns))
   (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-xl-done (tx code fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-txns))

; The overlay leg: the newest published overlay below the bound holding the
; query's key answers with its entry decoded at RB; else the bound moves
; below it, and past the last overlay the run leg starts. (mv code found
; txns fields)
(defun fn2-xl-overlay (tx sid qb rb qk qs qg fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlay-index-wfp fn2-overlay-index)
              (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-entry fn2-fields-rows fn2-overlays-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp qb) (natp rb)
                    (<= (+ qb *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (<= (+ rb *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
       (mv :bounds nil fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields))
      (rows (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))
      (o (fn2-xl-newest-frozen rows 0 sid (fn2-succ-txns-lbound tx fn2-succ-txns) rows fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (< o rows))
       (let ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-runs*) (lbound *fn2-u60-max*))))
        (mv :more nil fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields)))
      ((mv code pos order fn2-fields) (fn2-ov-locate o rb qb qk qs qg fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code nil fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields))
      ((when (eq order :eq))
       (b* (((mv code & fn2-fields) (fn2-ov-entry o pos rb fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
        (mv code (eq code :ok) fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields)))
      (seq (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 60 seq)) (mv :bounds nil fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields))
      (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-set-lbound tx seq fn2-succ-txns)))
  (mv :more nil fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-xl-overlay (tx sid qb rb qk qs qg fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 ((fn2-succ-txns 2) (fn2-fields 3)) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool) t
 (fn2-xl-newest-frozen fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-entry fn2-succ-txns-lbound fn2-overlays-seq))

; The run leg, between runs: start the cursor in the newest live run of SID
; below the bound, or answer :absent past the last.
(defun fn2-xl-run-next (tx sid rb fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-cursors))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-run-cursor-start fn2-xl-done)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp rb)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors))
      (rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      (r (fn2-succ-newest-run rows 0 sid (fn2-succ-txns-lbound tx fn2-succ-txns) rows fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (natp r) (< r rows)))
       (mv-let (code fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-xl-done tx :absent fn2-succ-txns) (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors)))
      ((mv code fn2-run-cursors)
       (fn2-run-cursor-start tx sid (fn2-run-installed-top r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-slot r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-gen r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-unit r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-counter r fn2-run-installed) rb
                             (fn2-run-installed-okind r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-oslot r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-ogen r fn2-run-installed) fn2-run-cursors))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors))
      (run (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (unsigned-byte-p 60 run) (unsigned-byte-p 32 r))) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors))
      (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-scan*) (lbound run) (lrow r))))
  (mv :more fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-xl-run-next (tx sid rb fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors)
 (fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors) t
 (fn2-succ-newest-run fn2-run-cursor-start fn2-xl-done fn2-succ-txns-lbound fn2-run-installed-run
  fn2-run-installed-top fn2-run-installed-slot fn2-run-installed-gen fn2-run-installed-unit fn2-run-installed-counter
  fn2-run-installed-okind fn2-run-installed-oslot fn2-run-installed-ogen))

; One call of TX's lookup of the key at QB (owner QK QS QG) in SID: :ok with
; the entry decoded at the returned row, :absent, :more (call again), :miss
; (a run page to load), or a refusal. A run version that moved while the
; lookup was in the run leg restarts it from the newest overlay (a fact
; that moved from an overlay already passed into a new run is met again).
; (mv code erow txns cursors paths fields)
(defun fn2-xl-step (tx sid budget qb rb qk qs qg fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                    fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths
                          fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlay-index-wfp fn2-overlay-index)
              (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-cursors) (fn2-run-paths-wfp fn2-run-paths)
              (fn2-run-cache-wfp fn2-run-cache) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (natp budget))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-xl-restart fn2-xl-done fn2-xl-overlay fn2-xl-run-next fn2-run-lookup-step
                                            fn2-fields-rows fn2-succ-txns-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp rb) (natp qb)))
       (mv :bounds 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields))
      (lphase (fn2-succ-txns-lphase tx fn2-succ-txns)))
  (cond
   ((equal lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-idle*)
    (mv-let (code fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-xl-restart tx sid fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed)
     (mv code 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
   ((equal lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-overlays*)
    (b* (((mv code found fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields)
          (fn2-xl-overlay tx sid qb rb qk qs qg fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool))
         ((when found) (mv-let (c fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-xl-done tx :ok fn2-succ-txns)
                        (mv c rb fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields))))
     (mv code 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
   ((not (equal (fn2-run-version sid (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed) fn2-run-installed)
                (fn2-succ-txns-lver tx fn2-succ-txns)))
    (mv-let (code fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-xl-restart tx sid fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed)
     (mv code 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
   ((equal lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-runs*)
    (mv-let (code fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors) (fn2-xl-run-next tx sid rb fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors)
     (mv code 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
   (t
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)
          (fn2-run-lookup-step tx budget qb qk qs qg fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
     (case code
      (:found (mv-let (c fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-xl-done tx :ok fn2-succ-txns)
               (mv c (+ rb *fn2-run-reader-entry*) fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
      (:absent (let ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-set-lphase tx *fn2-succ-lookup-runs* fn2-succ-txns)))
                (mv :more 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
      (otherwise (mv code 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields))))))))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-xl-step (tx sid budget qb rb qk qs qg fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                               fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 ((fn2-succ-txns 2) (fn2-run-cursors 3) (fn2-run-paths 4) (fn2-fields 5))
 (fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool) t
 (fn2-xl-restart fn2-xl-done fn2-xl-overlay fn2-xl-run-next fn2-run-lookup-step fn2-succ-txns-lphase fn2-succ-txns-lver))
(defthm fn2-xl-step-natp
 (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-xl-step tx sid budget qb rb qk qs qg fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                              fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-xl-step))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)

; The group lookup (seam S-GROUP) for transaction TX: the newsgroup name is
; the LEN octets at [OFF, OFF+LEN) of SLOT/GEN, readable under OKIND OSLOT
; OGEN; each call passes the same name. (mv code group txns cursors paths
; fields): :ok with the group identifier, :absent (441), :more, :miss.
; SID's exact name lookup: a name of at most MAX octets to the entry's
; integer field VFIELD (the group directory's, fn2-principals').
(defun fn2-grp-lookup (sid max vfield tx slot gen off len okind oslot ogen budget b0
                       fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-decides fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                       fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-decides fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                          fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool) :guard t
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-xl-step fn2-fields-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-id-decides-wfp fn2-id-decides) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)
                    (fn2-overlay-index-wfp fn2-overlay-index) (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)
                    (fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-cursors) (fn2-run-paths-wfp fn2-run-paths) (fn2-run-cache-wfp fn2-run-cache)
                    (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))
       (mv :state 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (< tx (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides))
                    (natp b0) (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (natp budget) (<= budget 4096)
                    (natp sid) (natp max) (natp vfield) (posp len) (<= len max) (unsigned-byte-p 32 len) (unsigned-byte-p 32 slot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 gen)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 off) (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind) (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
       (mv :bounds 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (member (fn2-id-decides-phase tx fn2-id-decides) (list *fn2-id-decide-phase-idle* *fn2-id-decide-phase-done*))
                    (not (equal (fn2-succ-txns-rstate tx fn2-succ-txns) *fn2-succ-resolve-look*))))
       (mv :state 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields))
      (qb (+ b0 *fn2-idc-eb*)) (rb (+ b0 *fn2-idc-rb*))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put qb (value 0) (ref-slot slot) (ref-gen gen) (ref-off off) (ref-len len)))
      ((mv code erow fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)
       (fn2-xl-step tx sid budget qb rb okind oslot ogen fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index
                    fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields))
      (row (+ erow vfield))
      ((unless (< row (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))) (mv :bounds 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
  (mv :ok (fn2-fields-value row fn2-fields) fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-grp-lookup (sid max vfield tx slot gen off len okind oslot ogen budget b0
                                  fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-decides fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                                  fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 ((fn2-succ-txns 2) (fn2-run-cursors 3) (fn2-run-paths 4) (fn2-fields 5))
 (fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-decides fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool) t
 (fn2-xl-step fn2-id-decides-phase fn2-succ-txns-rstate))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The identity decision (C §4a, seam C-S1). For transaction TX's offer (N,
; C): the summary of N, then the candidate (N, C), each one exact lookup of
; the query at the transaction's lookup area (+4: the namespace, the name
; octets, the profile, the algorithm, the digest octets, read under the
; offer's owner). A fixed number of exact reads, whatever N's candidates,
; evidence and history number: no block walk and no per-name bound.
(defconst *fn2-id-summary-sid* 13)
(defconst *fn2-id-candidates-sid* 12)

; An integer field of the entry decoded at ROW, as a u60 (0 past the table).
(defun fn2-id-field (row fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)))
 (let ((v (if (and (natp row) (< row (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))) (fn2-fields-value row fn2-fields) 0)))
  (if (unsigned-byte-p 60 v) v 0)))
(defthm fn2-id-field-natp (natp (fn2-id-field row fn2-fields)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(defthm fn2-id-field-u60 (unsigned-byte-p 60 (fn2-id-field row fn2-fields)))
(defthm fn2-id-field-bound (< (fn2-id-field row fn2-fields) 1152921504606846976) :rule-classes :linear)
(in-theory (disable fn2-id-field))

; Start TX's decision for the name [MOFF, MOFF+MLEN) of MSLOT/MGEN and the
; digest [DOFF, DOFF+32) of DSLOT/DGEN, both readable under OKIND OSLOT OGEN
; until the decision is done. The decision must be idle or done and resolve
; not inside a run descent (they share the transaction's lookup).
(defun fn2-id-decide-start (tx mslot mgen moff mlen dslot dgen doff okind oslot ogen b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-decides fn2-fields) :guard t))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-id-decides-wfp fn2-id-decides) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)))
       (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-decides fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (< tx (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides))
                    (natp b0) (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (posp mlen) (<= mlen 250) (unsigned-byte-p 32 mslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 mgen) (unsigned-byte-p 32 moff)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 dslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 dgen) (unsigned-byte-p 32 doff)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind) (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-decides fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (equal (fn2-succ-txns-source-receipt tx fn2-succ-txns) 0)
                    (member (fn2-id-decides-phase tx fn2-id-decides) (list *fn2-id-decide-phase-idle* *fn2-id-decide-phase-done*))
                    (not (equal (fn2-succ-txns-rstate tx fn2-succ-txns) *fn2-succ-resolve-look*))))
       (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-decides fn2-fields))
      (q (+ b0 *fn2-idc-eb*))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put q (value *fn2-identity-namespace-netnews*) (ref-len 0)))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put (+ q 1) (value 0) (ref-slot mslot) (ref-gen mgen) (ref-off moff) (ref-len mlen)))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put (+ q 2) (value *fn2-identity-profile-source*) (ref-len 0)))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put (+ q 3) (value *fn2-identity-algorithm-blake3*) (ref-len 0)))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put (+ q 4) (value 1) (ref-slot dslot) (ref-gen dgen) (ref-off doff) (ref-len 32)))
      ((mv & fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-xl-done tx :ok fn2-succ-txns))
      (fn2-id-decides (fn2-id-decides-put tx (phase *fn2-id-decide-phase-summary*) (qk okind) (qs oslot) (qg ogen)

; Public TX APIs run under the existing exclusive staging-row ownership
; domain. Their retained receipt is the endpoint incarnation across yields;
; it is never replaced by sampling a reused endpoint or by a fake ML owner.
; Resolve/identity foreign continuations are rejected before touching a hold.
(defmacro fn2-directory-source-core-definition (name sid maximum value-field result)
 `(defun ,name (tx slot gen off len okind oslot ogen budget fn2-core)
   (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
   (stobj-let ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-core-succ-txns fn2-core)) (fn2-id-decides (fn2-core-id-decides fn2-core))
               (fn2-overlays (fn2-core-overlays fn2-core)) (fn2-overlay-index (fn2-core-overlay-index fn2-core))
               (fn2-run-installed (fn2-core-run-installed fn2-core)) (fn2-run-cursors (fn2-core-run-cursors fn2-core))
               (fn2-run-paths (fn2-core-run-paths fn2-core)) (fn2-run-cache (fn2-core-run-cache fn2-core))
               (fn2-fields (fn2-core-fields fn2-core)) (fn2-pool (fn2-core-pool fn2-core)) (fn2-fc (fn2-core-fc fn2-core))
               (fn2-reads (fn2-core-reads fn2-core)) (fn2-c-source-control (fn2-core-c-source-control fn2-core))
               (fn2-c-source-readers (fn2-core-c-source-readers fn2-core)))
    (code ,result fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers)
    (b* (((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (< tx (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides))))
          (mv :bounds 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers))
         ((unless (and (member (fn2-id-decides-phase tx fn2-id-decides) (list *fn2-id-decide-phase-idle* *fn2-id-decide-phase-done*))
                       ; Resolver holds span every slot, including FRESH/NEXT.
                       ; Only a live direct XL continuation may reuse this hold.
                       (or (equal (fn2-succ-txns-source-receipt tx fn2-succ-txns) 0)
                           (not (equal (fn2-succ-txns-lphase tx fn2-succ-txns) *fn2-succ-lookup-idle*)))
                       (not (equal (fn2-succ-txns-rstate tx fn2-succ-txns) *fn2-succ-resolve-look*))))
          (mv :state 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers))
         ((mv c b0) (fn2-idc-stripe tx (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) fn2-id-decides fn2-fields))
         ((unless (eq c :ok)) (mv c 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers))
         (readrows (fn2-reads-rows fn2-reads))
         ((mv admitted fn2-succ-txns fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers)
          (fn2-succ-source-acquire tx readrows fn2-succ-txns fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers))
         ((unless (eq admitted :ok))
          (mv (if (eq admitted :busy) :more :state) 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers))
         ((mv answer ,result fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)
          (fn2-grp-lookup ,sid ,maximum ,value-field tx slot gen off len okind oslot ogen budget b0
           fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-decides fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool))
         ((when (member-eq answer '(:more :miss)))
          (mv answer ,result fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers))
         ; The result is already scalar. Clear all decoded source references
         ; and the cursor before releasing this exact retained receipt.
         ((mv closed fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-fields fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers)
          (fn2-succ-source-close tx readrows b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-fields fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers)))
     (mv (if (eq closed :ok) answer :state) (if (eq closed :ok) ,result 0)
      fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields fn2-c-source-control fn2-c-source-readers))
    (mv code ,result fn2-core))))

(defmacro fn2-groups-core-events ()
 '(progn

    :position 2 :rows nil :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-core-wfp))))
   (defun fn2-groups-genesis (profile fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (if (equal (mv-nth 0 (fn2-csnapshot-state fn2-core)) *fn2-csnapshot-phase-held*)
        (mv :full fn2-core)
    (stobj-let ((fn2-id-engine (fn2-core-id-engine fn2-core)) (fn2-id-decides (fn2-core-id-decides fn2-core))
                (fn2-overlays (fn2-core-overlays fn2-core)) (fn2-overlay-index (fn2-core-overlay-index fn2-core))
                (fn2-fields (fn2-core-fields fn2-core)) (fn2-pool (fn2-core-pool fn2-core)) (fn2-fc (fn2-core-fc fn2-core)))
     (code fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
     (mv-let (c b0) (fn2-idc-stripe 0 (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
      (if (eq c :ok)
          (fn2-grp-genesis *fn2-groups-sid* *fn2-groups-name-max* (fn2-profile-get :groups profile) b0 fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
        (mv c fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)))

   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-groups-genesis (profile fn2-core)
    :position 1 :rows nil :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-core-wfp))))
   ;; The principal directory's exact lookup (principal-create's repeat,
   ;; principal-bind): NAME's durable id, or :absent.
   (fn2-directory-source-core-definition fn2-principal-lookup *fn2-principals-sid* *fn2-principals-name-max* *fn2-principals-entry-field-principal* principal)
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-principal-lookup (tx slot gen off len okind oslot ogen budget fn2-core)
    :position 2 :rows nil :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-core-wfp))))
   ;; The store's two persisted principals (AUTHORITY-20261105 section 1): the
   ;; anonymous account (slot 0) and the owner's, each bound once here
   ;; (incarnation 0 -> 1, so every durable principal id is positive and 0
   ;; stays the none value), then named in fn2-principals' genesis overlay.
   ;; Both ids are functions of the profile, so every boot names them alike.
   (defun fn2-principals-bind-genesis (profile fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (stobj-let ((fn2-accounts (fn2-core-accounts fn2-core)))
     (code ids fn2-accounts)
     (if (and (fn2-accountsp fn2-accounts) (fn2-accounts-wfp fn2-accounts) (fn2-accounts-shapep fn2-accounts)
              (< 0 (fn2-accounts-rows fn2-accounts)))
         (b* ((o (fn2-principals-owner-slot profile))
              (owner (< (+ 1 o) (fn2-accounts-rows fn2-accounts)))
              ((mv c0 fn2-accounts) (fn2-account-rebind 0 fn2-accounts))
              ((mv c1 fn2-accounts) (if owner (fn2-account-rebind o fn2-accounts) (mv :ok fn2-accounts)))
              ((unless (and (eq c0 :ok) (eq c1 :ok))) (mv :state nil fn2-accounts)))
          (mv :ok (cons (cons "anonymous" (fn2-account-principal-id 0 fn2-accounts))
                        (and owner (list (cons "owner" (fn2-account-principal-id o fn2-accounts)))))
              fn2-accounts))
       (mv :state nil fn2-accounts))
     (mv code ids fn2-core)))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-principals-bind-genesis (profile fn2-core)
    :position 2 :rows nil :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-core-wfp))))
   ;; The accounts are bound under every profile (the ids are functions of
   ;; the profile); the names are written only where the profile serves
   ;; authority (:authority rows, fn2-auth): that is where principal-create
   ;; and principal-bind read them, and where the profile must give the
   ;; directory its overlay. A profile serving no authority (the tiny unit
   ;; profiles) has no reader of the names and need not hold the overlay.
      ; Read already-bound actor identities. This never increments incarnation.
   ; The owner slot is trusted startup configuration; IDs come from accounts.
   (defun fn2-principals-bound-genesis-ids (owner-slot fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (stobj-let ((fn2-accounts (fn2-core-accounts fn2-core))) (code ids)
     (if (and (fn2-accountsp fn2-accounts) (fn2-accounts-wfp fn2-accounts) (fn2-accounts-shapep fn2-accounts)
              (natp owner-slot) (< 0 (fn2-accounts-rows fn2-accounts)))
         (let* ((owner (< (+ 1 owner-slot) (fn2-accounts-rows fn2-accounts)))
                (anonymous (fn2-account-principal-id 0 fn2-accounts))
                (owner-id (if owner (fn2-account-principal-id owner-slot fn2-accounts) 0)))
          (if (and (posp (fn2-accounts-incarnation 0 fn2-accounts)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 anonymous)
                   (or (not owner) (and (posp (fn2-accounts-incarnation owner-slot fn2-accounts))
                                        (unsigned-byte-p 60 owner-id))))
              (mv :ok (cons (cons "anonymous" anonymous) (and owner (list (cons "owner" owner-id)))))
            (mv :state nil)))
       (mv :state nil))
     (mv code ids)))

    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (mv-let (code ids) (fn2-principals-bound-genesis-ids (fn2-principals-owner-slot profile) fn2-core)
     (if (or (not (eq code :ok)) (not (posp (nfix (fn2-profile-get :authority profile)))))
         (mv code fn2-core)
      (stobj-let ((fn2-id-engine (fn2-core-id-engine fn2-core)) (fn2-id-decides (fn2-core-id-decides fn2-core))
                  (fn2-overlays (fn2-core-overlays fn2-core)) (fn2-overlay-index (fn2-core-overlay-index fn2-core))
                  (fn2-fields (fn2-core-fields fn2-core)) (fn2-pool (fn2-core-pool fn2-core)) (fn2-fc (fn2-core-fc fn2-core)))
       (code fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
       (mv-let (c b0) (fn2-idc-stripe 0 (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
        (if (eq c :ok)

                             fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
          (mv c fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)))

    :position 1 :rows nil :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-core-wfp))))
   ; Preserve the original nonimage/public operation: bind once, then write
   ; the authority NAME overlay from those same actual bound identities.
   (defun fn2-principals-genesis (profile fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (mv-let (code ids fn2-core) (fn2-principals-bind-genesis profile fn2-core)
     (declare (ignore ids))

   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-principals-genesis (profile fn2-core)
    :position 1 :rows nil :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-core-wfp))))

   (defun fn2-principal-of-slot (p fn2-core)

              (natp p) (< p (fn2-accounts-rows fn2-accounts)))
         (mv :ok (fn2-account-principal-id p fn2-accounts))
       (mv :state 0))
     (mv code (nfix id))))
   (in-theory (disable fn2-group-lookup fn2-groups-genesis fn2-principal-lookup fn2-principals-bind-genesis
                       fn2-principals-genesis fn2-principals-name-genesis fn2-principals-bound-genesis-ids fn2-principal-of-slot))
   (assert-event (fn2-assert-compliant-p '(fn2-group-lookup fn2-groups-genesis fn2-principal-lookup
                                          fn2-principals-genesis fn2-principal-of-slot) (w state)))))

before.machines-c-successor.lisp:
; Layer C in the served core, seam C-S3 (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §8 item 8):
; every engine write of a transaction goes through its batch's private
; successor. A transaction's write slots are declared at :prepare (put, arg,
; arg-octets, resolve); in its :ready arm, in one transition, stage computes
; every slot's row against the tip and holds room, out reads an assigned
; value, B admits the member, and bind writes every row into the batch's
; private overlays; release frees the slots at the outcome. B's commit kind
; publishes a batch (its private overlays, of every schema, readable in one
; step) or drops it. The tables, the engine row, the defcosts and the core
; wrappers (fn2-successor-prepare-events and -commit-events, materialized in
; assembly-callbacks-c-prepare and -commit) are three books': this one holds the tables,
; the declaring calls (put, arg, arg-octets) and resolve; machines-c-stage
; stage and out; machines-c-bind bind, release, publication, the defcosts
; and the wrappers (C-SUCCESSOR-BOOK).
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-sealer-kind")
(include-book "identity-workspace-geometry")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
;; The assembly's dispatchers case-split over every schema id when open; the
;; successor treats them as opaque (their type facts are the assembly's).
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; C-ENGINE-OWNER (as built, C1c): the engine's workspaces (overlay arenas,
; the bind scratch, the sealer's pages) are owned by the sealer machine's row:
; kind = fn2-sealer's position in the registry (the index's *FN2-SEALER-KIND*,
; asserted equal in machines-c-sealer.lisp), local slot 0, generation 1. The
; local slot, not the global id, because these constants are used before the
; index exists.
(make-event (value `(defconst *fn2-idc-owner-kind*

(assert-event (<= (+ *fn2-succ-res* *fn2-succ-values-max*) *fn2-succ-fresh*))

;; Every assembled schema and fold fits the inventory-derived slot; all
;; readable value fields fit RES, and its octets fit the actual scratch class.
(defun fn2-succ-kinds-fit (sid kinds)

 (or (atom kinds) (and (<= (nfix (fn2-fold-arity sid (car kinds))) *fn2-succ-fields-max*) (fn2-succ-kinds-fit sid (cdr kinds)))))

(defun fn2-succ-schemas-fit (ids)

     (let* ((sid (car ids)) (nf (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0)))
      (and (<= nf *fn2-succ-fields-max*)
           (<= (- nf (fn2-run-layout-keys sid)) *fn2-succ-values-max*)
           (fn2-succ-kinds-fit sid *fn2-run-fold-kinds*)
           (<= (fn2-succ-octets-total sid 0 nf) *fn2-idc-scratch-bytes*)
           (fn2-succ-schemas-fit (cdr ids))))))

; Tables. The engine row: the bind scratch (held once taken), the arena

; resolve's progress (slot RI, run bound RBOUND), and an exact lookup's
; (machines-c-groups.lisp: LPHASE, LBOUND, LROW, LVER). A slot row (row
; T * 24 + I): schema, kind (:insert, or one of the folds' event
; kinds), the masks of args given (SET), given :event (EVENTS) and given
; :out (OUTS), what resolve found (FOUND, the schema's run version VRUN), the

  (fn2-fields-put to (value (fn2-fields-value from fn2-fields)) (ref-slot (fn2-fields-ref-slot from fn2-fields))

       ((not (and (natp from) (natp to) (< (+ from n -1) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (< (+ to n -1) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
        fn2-fields)

           (fn2-succ-copy-rows (- n 1) (+ 1 from) (+ 1 to) fn2-fields)))))
(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-succ-copy-rows (n from to fn2-fields) :position nil :raw-rows t)

                 :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp n) (natp base))))

       ((not (and (natp base) (< (+ base n -1) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))) fn2-fields)
       (t (let ((fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put (+ base n -1)
                              (ref-slot 0) (ref-gen 0) (ref-off 0) (ref-len 0))))

 (if (not (and (natp from) (natp to) (< from (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (< to (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))) fn2-fields

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Declaring writes (at :prepare).

; Slot I of transaction TX writes schema SID by KIND: a fold event kind of
; SID, or :insert (a whole entry of a :unique, :latest or :union schema that
; is not a fold); or reads it by :depend, the transaction's read dependency
; (EXCELLENCE-ASTRA section 1B): a whole entry of a fold, :unique or :latest
; schema, its key and the value fields the transaction decided on, all
; integers given as values; stage answers :changed unless the key's row at
; the tip (the immediate predecessor's, an earlier prepared batch's
; included) holds exactly those values, and the slot binds nothing. Any change to a transaction's slots leaves it :open (stage
; again) and restarts resolve.
(defun fn2-succ-put (tx i sid kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) :guard t))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots))) (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*)
                    (< (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i) (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 sid)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (member (fn2-succ-txns-phase tx fn2-succ-txns)
                       (list *fn2-succ-phase-idle* *fn2-succ-phase-open* *fn2-succ-phase-staged*)))
       (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      (code (fn2-succ-kind-keyword->code kind))
      ((unless (natp code)) (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (< 0 (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0))) (mv :schema fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (cond ((equal code *fn2-succ-kind-insert*)
                      (and (not (fn2-run-layout-fold-p sid)) (member-eq (fn2-run-layout-merge sid) '(:unique :latest :union))))
                     ((equal code *fn2-succ-kind-depend*)
                      (or (fn2-run-layout-fold-p sid) (member-eq (fn2-run-layout-merge sid) '(:unique :latest))))
                     (t (natp (fn2-fold-arity sid kind)))))
       (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      (s (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i))
      (fn2-succ-slots (fn2-succ-slots-put s (phase *fn2-succ-slot-phase-put*) (sid sid) (kind code) (set 0) (events 0) (outs 0)
                                          (found 0) (vrun 0) (size 0) (oset 0) (sk 0) (ss 0) (sg 0) (late 0) (filled 0) (unchanged 0)))
      (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (phase *fn2-succ-phase-open*) (ri 0)
                                        (rstate *fn2-succ-resolve-fresh*) (rbound 0))))
  (mv :ok fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-succ-put (tx i sid kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) t
 (fn2-succ-txns-phase))

         (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (phase *fn2-succ-phase-open*) (ri 0) (rstate *fn2-succ-resolve-fresh*) (rbound 0))))

; The slot row of slot I of TX when it is declared and TX is :open or
; :staged: (mv code s sid code arity).
(defun fn2-succ-declared (tx i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*)
                    (< (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i) (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))))
       (mv :bounds 0 0 0 0))
      ((unless (member (fn2-succ-txns-phase tx fn2-succ-txns) (list *fn2-succ-phase-open* *fn2-succ-phase-staged*))) (mv :state 0 0 0 0))
      (s (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i))
      ((when (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase s fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*)) (mv :state 0 0 0 0))
      (sid (fn2-succ-slots-sid s fn2-succ-slots)) (code (fn2-succ-slots-kind s fn2-succ-slots)))
  (mv :ok s sid code (fn2-succ-arity sid code))))
(defthm fn2-succ-declared-types
 (and (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-succ-declared tx i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)))
      (natp (mv-nth 4 (fn2-succ-declared tx i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))))
 :rule-classes ((:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-succ-declared tx i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))))
                (:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 4 (fn2-succ-declared tx i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-succ-declared))

; Arg J of slot I of TX from SRC: :value (the integer VALUE), :event (the
; member's commit position, written at bind; an insert's integer field, or a
; fold arg its :set copies straight into a value field, fn2-fold-event-field), or
; :out (VALUE = K * 2^8 + F: integer field F of slot K < I's staged row;
; never a fold's key arg, which resolve must read),
; or :new (VALUE = K: 1 when slot K < I staged fresh, 0 when it binds
; nothing; never a fold's key arg; C §4a). An assigned arg takes no call. B0 is TX's stripe base. :ok, :bounds,
; :state, :kind.
(defun fn2-succ-arg (tx i j src value b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) :guard t :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-pool-reserve fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-reset fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write
                                             fn2-pool-class-for fn2-ov-start fn2-ov-advance fn2-ov-insert
                                             fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-entry fn2-run-copy-row fn2-fold-apply fn2-fold-assign
                                             fn2-run-layout-size fn2-run-lookup-step fn2-run-cursor-start
                                             fn2-fields-rows fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-overlays-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)))
       (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((mv code s sid kcode n) (fn2-succ-declared tx i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*) (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                    (natp j) (< j n) (< j *fn2-succ-fields-max*) (natp b0)
                    (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 value)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (kw (fn2-succ-kindkw kcode))
      (insert (equal kcode *fn2-succ-kind-insert*)) (depend (equal kcode *fn2-succ-kind-depend*))
      (fold (not (or insert depend)))
      ((when (or (and (or insert depend) (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid j)) (and depend (not (eq src :value))) (and fold (fn2-fold-assigned-p sid kw j))
                 (and fold (fn2-succ-octet-field sid kcode j))))
       (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ;; :out VALUE is K*256+F; :new VALUE is the slot K.
      (k (if (eq src :new) value (floor value 256))) (f (if (eq src :new) 0 (mod value 256)))
      (ks (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) k))
      ((unless (case src
                (:value t)
                (:event (or insert (and fold (natp (fn2-fold-event-field sid kw j)))))
                (:new (and (< k i) (< ks (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                           (not (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase ks fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*))
                           (not (and fold (fn2-succ-key-arg-p (fn2-run-layout-keys sid) 0 sid kw j)))))
                (:out (and (< k i) (< ks (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                           (not (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase ks fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*))
                           (< f (fn2-run-layout-fields (fn2-succ-slots-sid ks fn2-succ-slots) 0))
                           (not (fn2-run-layout-octets-max (fn2-succ-slots-sid ks fn2-succ-slots) f))
                           (not (and fold (fn2-succ-key-arg-p (fn2-run-layout-keys sid) 0 sid kw j)))))
                (otherwise nil)))
       (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (row (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i) *fn2-succ-raw* j))
      ((unless (< row (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (bit (fn2-succ-bit j))
      (set (logior (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-set s fn2-succ-slots)) bit))
      (events (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-events s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      (outs (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-outs s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      (late (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-late s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      ;; (:new K) is an :out of slot K's fresh row.
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put row (value (case src (:event 0) (:new (+ (* 256 k) *fn2-succ-fresh*)) (otherwise value)))
                                  (ref-len 0)))
      ((mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)
       (fn2-succ-touch tx s set (if (eq src :event) (logior events bit) events)
                       (if (member-eq src '(:out :new)) (logior outs bit) outs) late
                       fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)))
  (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-succ-arg (tx i j src value b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)
 (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) t
 (fn2-succ-slots-phase fn2-succ-slots-kind fn2-succ-slots-sid fn2-succ-slots-set fn2-succ-slots-events fn2-succ-slots-outs
  fn2-succ-slots-late fn2-run-layout-octets-max fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-succ-key-arg-p fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys
  fn2-succ-octet-field fn2-fold-event-field))

; Octet arg J of insert slot I of TX: LEN octets at [OFF, OFF+LEN) of
; SLOT/GEN, readable under OKIND OSLOT OGEN until bind (which copies them
; into the arena); every octet arg of a slot under one owner (:owner).
(defun fn2-succ-arg-octets (tx i j slot gen off len okind oslot ogen b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) :guard t :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-pool-reserve fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-reset fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write
                                             fn2-pool-class-for fn2-ov-start fn2-ov-advance fn2-ov-insert
                                             fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-entry fn2-run-copy-row fn2-fold-apply fn2-fold-assign
                                             fn2-run-layout-size fn2-run-lookup-step fn2-run-cursor-start
                                             fn2-fields-rows fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-overlays-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)))
       (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((mv code s sid kcode n) (fn2-succ-declared tx i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*) (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                    (natp j) (< j n) (< j *fn2-succ-fields-max*) (natp b0)
                    (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 slot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 gen) (unsigned-byte-p 32 off) (unsigned-byte-p 32 len)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind) (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (f (fn2-succ-octet-field sid kcode j))
      ((unless f) (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((unless (fn2-run-layout-value-ok sid f len)) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((when (and (equal (fn2-succ-slots-oset s fn2-succ-slots) 1)
                  (not (and (equal (fn2-succ-slots-sk s fn2-succ-slots) okind) (equal (fn2-succ-slots-ss s fn2-succ-slots) oslot)
                            (equal (fn2-succ-slots-sg s fn2-succ-slots) ogen)))))
       (mv :owner fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (row (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i) *fn2-succ-raw* j))
      ((unless (< row (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (bit (fn2-succ-bit j))
      (set (logior (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-set s fn2-succ-slots)) bit))
      (events (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-events s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      (outs (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-outs s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      ; A digest field's row carries the codec's presence value 1 (an octet
      ; field's value is unused); a digest admits only length 32, so a length
      ; of 0 tells it apart from (:octets 32).
      (digest (not (fn2-run-layout-value-ok sid f 0)))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put row (value (if digest 1 0)) (ref-slot slot) (ref-gen gen) (ref-off off) (ref-len len)))
      (late (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-late s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      (fn2-succ-slots (fn2-succ-slots-put s (oset 1) (sk okind) (ss oslot) (sg ogen)))
      ((mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-succ-touch tx s set events outs late fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)))
  (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-succ-arg-octets (tx i j slot gen off len okind oslot ogen b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)
 (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) t
 (fn2-succ-slots-oset fn2-succ-slots-sk fn2-succ-slots-ss fn2-succ-slots-sg fn2-succ-slots-set fn2-succ-slots-events
  fn2-succ-slots-outs fn2-succ-slots-late fn2-run-layout-octets-max fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-succ-octet-field))

; Late octet arg J of insert slot I of TX (C-S3a): at most MAX octets,
; given by fn2-succ-fill-octets after stage and before bind. Stage sizes
; the entry by MAX (the raw row's length), so the room held covers any fill.
; A key field (the tip and resolve read keys at stage) and a digest field
; are :kind; MAX past the field's octet bound is :bounds.
(defun fn2-succ-arg-octets-late (tx i j max b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) :guard t :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-pool-reserve fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-reset fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write
                                             fn2-pool-class-for fn2-ov-start fn2-ov-advance fn2-ov-insert
                                             fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-entry fn2-run-copy-row fn2-fold-apply fn2-fold-assign
                                             fn2-run-layout-size fn2-run-lookup-step fn2-run-cursor-start
                                             fn2-fields-rows fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-overlays-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)))
       (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((mv code s sid kcode n) (fn2-succ-declared tx i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*) (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                    (natp j) (< j n) (< j *fn2-succ-fields-max*) (natp b0)
                    (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (unsigned-byte-p 32 max)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (equal kcode *fn2-succ-kind-insert*) (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid j)
                    (fn2-run-layout-value-ok sid j 0) (<= (nfix (fn2-run-layout-keys sid)) j)))
       (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((unless (fn2-run-layout-value-ok sid j max)) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (row (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i) *fn2-succ-raw* j))
      ((unless (< row (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (bit (fn2-succ-bit j))
      (set (logior (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-set s fn2-succ-slots)) bit))
      (events (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-events s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      (outs (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-outs s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      (late (logior (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-late s fn2-succ-slots)) bit))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put row (value 0) (ref-slot 0) (ref-gen 0) (ref-off 0) (ref-len max)))
      ((mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-succ-touch tx s set events outs late fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)))
  (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-succ-arg-octets-late (tx i j max b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)
 (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) t
 (fn2-succ-slots-set fn2-succ-slots-events fn2-succ-slots-outs fn2-succ-slots-late fn2-run-layout-octets-max
  fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-keys))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Resolve (at :prepare): for every slot that reads its key's row (a fold's,
; or a :unique insert whose key args are all :value), the key's newest row
; in the installed runs, newest run first, into the slot's +36 rows, and the
; schema's run version, which stage compares. Bounded: one run selection or
; one lookup step per call. TX's run cursor is its decision's (cursor row
; TX), so a decision in progress refuses :state.

; The key fields of slot S's row at ENTRY from its args at SRC: a fold's
; key arg for each key field, an insert's first NK args.
(defun fn2-succ-key-rows (k kf nk sid kw insert src entry fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :measure (nfix k)
  :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp k) (natp kf) (natp src) (natp entry))))
 (if (or (zp k) (not (and (natp kf) (natp nk) (< kf nk)))) fn2-fields
  (let ((a (if insert kf (fn2-fold-key-arg sid kw kf))))
   (if (not (and (natp a) (natp src) (natp entry) (< (+ src a) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (< (+ entry kf) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
       fn2-fields
    (let ((fn2-fields (if (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid kf)
                          (fn2-succ-copy-row (+ src a) (+ entry kf) fn2-fields)
                        (fn2-fields-put (+ entry kf) (value (fn2-fields-value (+ src a) fn2-fields)) (ref-len 0)))))
     (fn2-succ-key-rows (- k 1) (+ 1 kf) nk sid kw insert src entry fn2-fields))))))
(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-succ-key-rows (k kf nk sid kw insert src entry fn2-fields) :position nil :raw-rows t
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fold-key-arg))))
; Whether slot S reads its key's row: a fold's or a dependency's (its key
; args are :value by arg's rule), or a :unique insert's whose key args are all given as values.
(defun fn2-succ-reads-key (s fn2-succ-slots)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-succ-slots :guard (and (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)))))
 (let* ((sid (fn2-succ-slots-sid s fn2-succ-slots)) (code (fn2-succ-slots-kind s fn2-succ-slots))
        (nk (nfix (fn2-run-layout-keys sid))) (mask (- (ash 1 nk) 1)))
  (cond ((equal code *fn2-succ-kind-insert*)
         (and (member-eq (fn2-run-layout-merge sid) '(:unique :union))
              (equal (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-set s fn2-succ-slots)) mask) mask)
              (equal (logand (logior (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-events s fn2-succ-slots)) (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-outs s fn2-succ-slots))) mask) 0)))
        (t t))))
; The live run of SID with the greatest identifier below BOUND, among rows
; R.. (K of them); BEST the best so far (a row, or the row count).
(defun fn2-succ-newest-run (k r sid bound best fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp k) (natp r))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) best
  (let ((run (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed)))
   (fn2-succ-newest-run (- k 1) (+ 1 r) sid bound
                        (if (and (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*)
                                 (equal (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed) sid) (< (nfix run) (nfix bound))
                                 (or (not (and (natp best) (< best (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))))
                                     (< (nfix (fn2-run-installed-run best fn2-run-installed)) (nfix run))))
                            r best)
                        fn2-run-installed))))
; Slot S is resolved: FOUND, its schema's run version noted at its start.
; (An empty slot, MARK nil, is passed over unchanged.)
(defun fn2-succ-resolved (tx s found mark fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots))))
 (if (not (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
               (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ 1 (nfix (fn2-succ-txns-ri tx fn2-succ-txns))))))
     (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)
  (let* ((fn2-succ-slots (if mark (fn2-succ-slots-put s (phase *fn2-succ-slot-phase-resolved*) (found (if found 1 0))) fn2-succ-slots))
         (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (ri (+ 1 (nfix (fn2-succ-txns-ri tx fn2-succ-txns)))) (rstate *fn2-succ-resolve-fresh*) (rbound 0))))
   (mv :more fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-succ-resolved (tx s found mark fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) t
 (fn2-succ-txns-ri))

;; Slot S at RI, its run search in state :next: start the lookup in the
;; newest run below the bound, or resolve the slot absent.
(defun fn2-succ-resolve-next (tx s b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)
              (fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-cursors) (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)) (natp b0))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-run-cursor-start fn2-succ-resolved)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)) (natp b0)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-run-cursors))
      (sid (fn2-succ-slots-sid s fn2-succ-slots))
      (rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      (r (fn2-succ-newest-run rows 0 sid (fn2-succ-txns-rbound tx fn2-succ-txns) rows fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (natp r) (< r rows)))
       (mv-let (code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-succ-resolved tx s nil t fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)
        (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-run-cursors)))
      ((mv code fn2-run-cursors)
       (fn2-run-cursor-start tx sid (fn2-run-installed-top r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-slot r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-gen r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-unit r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-counter r fn2-run-installed) (+ b0 *fn2-idc-rb*)
                             (fn2-run-installed-okind r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-oslot r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-ogen r fn2-run-installed) fn2-run-cursors))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-run-cursors))
